ciel.description: Invoke Ciel deep-reasoning workflow on a task
ciel.template:
Follow the Ciel CRÉER pipeline from AGENTS.md for the task described below. Start with QUOI (classify depth: Trivial/Standard/Critical), then proceed through each step in order. For Standard/Critical: dispatch @ciel-researcher and @ciel-explorer agents in parallel before FAIRE, then @ciel-critic after FAIRE.

Task: $ARGUMENTS

ciel-update.description: Update Ciel to the latest version from GitHub
ciel-update.template: Run `bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KaosKyun/Ciel/main/scripts/install.sh)"` to update Ciel. This will re-download and overwrite all Ciel files while preserving ciel-overlay.md.
